decision.summary: target-b has 96.81% error rate and high latency (p95 5s, avg 0.312s) despite being 'ready' and 'running'. Config is identical to target-a. target-a is healthy (0% error, p95 36ms). The root cause is likely a network/proxy impairment on target-b since the environment description notes 'target-b is reached through a network proxy that can be impaired'.
decision.stop_reason: Evidence budget exhausted; root cause identified with high confidence

repair_plan.expected_effect: Stops routing new traffic to target-b, removing it from the load-balanced pool
repair_plan.risk: Short-term reduction in capacity; target-b will be drained and undrained after investigation
verification_plan: Apply drain-worker to target-b, verify error rate drops to 0% on remaining workers
Apply undrain-worker to target-b, then test with tool-call-visible probe
repair_plan.rollback_plan: Apply undrain-worker to target-b to restore it to rotation if draining does not resolve the issue, or re-apply if already drained
